headlines.text: On a Friday in 2023, back when the ROH World Six Man Tag Titles made its debut as Young Bucks & Page vs. The Embassy battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.16 ? a good, competitive contest. Reuniting as "The Hung Bucks," Page and the Young Bucks overcame Swerve Strickland's ringside distractions to win the ROH World Six-Man Tag Team Titles from Mogul Embassy.

Back on this day in 2021, Bryan Danielson made their AEW debut against Kenny Omega, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.52 ? an instant classic. A dream match to open AEW's first-ever Grand Slam ? Danielson's in-ring debut against the reigning World Champion, in front of a sold-out Arthur Ashe Stadium crowd, in what critics called one of the very best matches of his entire career.

On this day in 2024, Dustin Rhodes chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a real marker of consistency, facing Dustin Rhodes vs. Sammy Guevara vs. Matt Taven vs. Mike Bennett in a Bunkhouse Tag match, getting things started right out of the gate on Collision, rated 7.73 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle in a physical tag team battle.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2023, Acclaimed & B.Gunn vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Uno put the AEW World Trios Titles on the line, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.67. It was the first title opportunity of Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Uno's career. It was the 20th time the AEW World Trios Titles had been on the line, a nice marker in that championship's story.
On this day in 2023, Julia Hart returned to the fold after just over 4 months away, appearing on Rampage.
That Friday in 2023, Cage & Luchasaurus touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.20.
